notes.title: 'Toymaker's Apprentice' now supports smooth locomotion!
notes.content: Due to overwhelming requests, we have added smooth locomotion (technically a cross between 'artificial smooth' and 'armswinger' locomotion) to the latest Steam update.   User can choose either teleportation (via beam cast) or smooth locomotion via 'back-and-forth' movement of the controllers while lightly touching the touchpad.   It's still in early testing phase, so appreciate user feedback.
